scope: TEST-only actual CLI resume/export engineering parity and descriptive process cost. Five completed-result cached fixtures copied from retained Round33 results; no unfinished scientific recomputation, independent model validation, or scientific GO claim. The separate genuine unfinished calibration export-failure regression is complementary evidence.

fixtureClasses.calibrate: completed-result cached; 72 observations, 12 entities, 12 calibration rows
fixtureClasses.variance: completed-result cached; 320 observations, 40 entities, 2 groups and 2 tracks
fixtureClasses.estimation: completed-result cached; 3 performance rows and 300 draws
fixtureClasses.melsm: completed-result cached; 96 observations, 8 subjects, 6 parameters, 0 random effects; not_converged diagnostic exit 2

fixturePreparation: Native baseline deserialization/serialization plus authorized deterministic AnalysisEngine.Build input aggregation; no new calibrate/analyze/variance/estimation/MELSM simulation, model fit, or resume. Retained Round33 candidate results are baseline data for Round34. Full source identities, constructor/request guards, fixed IDs/time and hashes in fixture manifest. Exact byte regeneration independently checked.

execution.restorationPolicy: MVS_DISABLE_BACKUPS absent. Each CLI process decodes the same immutable original checkpoint; MVS_BACKUP_DIR is a different empty private directory per invocation. Genuine restored session primary archive must exist, preserve exact Request and result bytes, unit keys, completion, ID/request hash and original environment-history prefix. Restored session publication timestamp may change; histories may only append one current environment.
execution.environmentPolicy: Minimal explicit environment plus frozen dotnet host PATH/DOTNET_ROOT; no inherited tuning. Per invocation isolated HOME/TMPDIR/MVS_APPDATA_ROOT/MVS_BACKUP_DIR. Same runtime/host/affinity, no installed plugins or external/user paths.
execution.cpuAffinity: Two lowest-numbered allowed CPUs frozen at binding; task child gets exactly this affinity.
execution.lifecycle: stdout/stderr exclusive-open precedes timer. Main thread blocks in wait4(exact_pid,0); first operation after return captures perf_counter_ns endpoint. An independent daemon watchdog checks timeout/affinity/RSS and SIGKILLs owned process group; main wait reaps and returns exact child rusage. Event notification and bounded watchdog join happen after the elapsed endpoint. No WNOHANG exit polling, no 50ms timer quantization.
execution.onFailure: Every launch/exit/watchdog failure is retained with stdout/stderr and record before validation. Continue all remaining planned attempts unless frozen provenance/input binding becomes invalid or user interruption/unresolved child cleanup stops the comparison. Do not delete, replace, cherry-rerun, or discard first runs. Incomplete sets and any failure cannot pass.
execution.timingAuthorization: No actual baseline/candidate resume invocation until lead explicitly approves an exclusive measurement window after final builds/tests. The --approved-exclusive-window flag is mandatory and does not create authority by itself.

comparisons.bytePolicy: Compare all CSV and scientific JSON byte-for-byte; only exact enumerated JSON token pointers are replaced. Preserve all unlisted whitespace, field order, numeric lexemes, scientific values, methods, status, nulls and row order. No parse/re-serialize normalization or tolerance.

calibration_state.json: /PayloadHash: independently verify raw unsigned JSON SHA256, then derive from timestamp-normalized unsigned exact bytes
run_manifest.json: /files/*/sha256 and /files/*/SizeBytes: independently verify raw artifact, then derive normalized artifact hash/length
stdout.json: /artifacts/*/sha256 and /artifacts/*/sizeBytes: independently verify raw artifact then derive normalized artifact hash/length
resumed_checkpoint.json: /SavedUtc only: newly published session timestamp, independently parsed; frozen original SavedUtc is never normalized

comparisons.integrity: Verify strict JSON duplicates/nonfinite rejection; regular output file set; unique machine artifact names and exact own-output paths; raw SHA256 and size independently; complete manifest association and runId/path relationship; raw calibration-state payload checksum; frozen input ZIP members/checksums/request checksum; resumed request and cached result exact bytes; original environment history preservation. Raw checkpoint ZIP bytes retained (ZIP metadata may differ); compare independently validated decoded document except SavedUtc.
comparisons.comparisonSet: All six runs per workload against first baseline, plus all three explicit paired A/B comparisons. Scientific status and process exit exact; MELSM expected diagnostic exit 2 is fixed in manifest.
comparisons.rawCapture: Every stdout, stderr, invocation context, exact resource record, generated output, newly saved backups/archives and normalization retained. Human stderr text retained but not scientific parity target.
comparisons.bindings: Bind exact production sources/binary directory manifests for both builds, dotnet host/CoreCLR, original fixture bytes/manifest, plan and driver; refuse overwrite. Check before/after each invocation. Verify performs no native or model rerun and is read-only: missing evidence is an error, never repaired.

performance.accounting: Linux blocking wait4(exact child PID,0) rusage; CPU user/system/total, kernel ru_maxrss KiB; monotonic wall immediately before Popen to immediate return from blocking wait. No cumulative-child resource accounting or WNOHANG polling.
performance.report: All 30 measurements, all three matched B/A ratios for every workload/metric, build medians/min/max and ratio medians/min/max, available counts and explicit null for unavailable/zero-baseline ratios. No speed acceptance threshold or significance claim.
limitations: Completed-result checkpoints intentionally measure real resume/session/cache/export/startup; no remaining scientific work or interruption-recovery claim.
Same-engine exact parity does not establish statistical correctness or validate retained result values.
Three pairs are descriptive only; startup/JIT/export/hash/backup I/O, OS caching and shared-host scheduling noise remain.
Independent watchdog observation adds some runtime overhead but does not define the timer endpoint. Kernel peak RSS includes process startup; sampled RSS is only a watchdog diagnostic.
Genuine unfinished calibration regression is separate from this completed-cache comparison.
No scientific release promotion; existing NO-GO remains.
Sampling timeout is not a hard real-time guarantee if process creation or system observation stalls; unresolved child cleanup aborts further launches.

infrastructureAmendment.change: At execute timer boundary convert timeout and interval to native float; operational timing only, no scientific payload conversion. Add actual parsed-plan success test and Decimal timeout/interval kill-reap test.
infrastructureAmendment.unchanged: Native sources, compiled binaries, input checkpoint bytes, scientific settings, cache contents, workload order, AB/BA/AB order, number of30 measured attempts, normalization, measurement endpoints and CPU/RSS collection.
infrastructureAmendment.policy: New attestation and complete new30 only after renewed exclusive GO. No selective attempt rerun or discarded failed measurements.
